approaches_tried.approach: Bare TOOL_JSON="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" assignment under set -u crashed with 'unbound variable' when CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT is unset (the degenerate empty-file_path test case) -- the OLD code avoided this because the equivalent reference lived inside a command substitution subshell, whose failure was caught by a trailing '|| true'; a bare top-level assignment has no such subshell to catch the set -u abort
